Clear all scope, back to the root

Source: R/scope.R
pz_find_reset.Rd

pz_find_reset() returns a context with an empty scope stack. No pinned set is released – contexts derived before the reset may still hold them – and resetting never mutates the context it was called on. At the root it is a no-op returning ctx unchanged.

Usage

pz_find_reset(ctx)

Arguments

ctx

A paparazzi context.

Value

A new root context, or ctx itself at the root.

See also

pz_find(), pz_find_pop()

Examples

page <- pz_open(pz_example("tasks"))
page |>
  pz_find(".task-list") |>
  pz_find_first(".task") |>
  pz_act_click(".task-done") |>
  # The help toggle is outside the list, so start again from the root
  pz_find_reset() |>
  pz_act_click("#toggle-help") |>
  pz_expect_visible(target = "#help") |>
  pz_get_text(target = "#help")
#> [1] "Type a task and press Enter to add it. Edit a title, mark a task done, or drag tasks to reorder them. Nothing is saved: reload or Start over resets the list."
pz_close(page)
